# What calf price do you need to break even on a cow?

> Free calculator for cattle producers: what a cow costs you a year, what her calf brings in, your breakeven calf price per hundredweight, and how hay price, weaning weight and calves weaned move it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cow-calf-breakeven-calculator/)
- [Breakeven calf price per cwt: what a cow really costs, and why hay and weaning rate decide it](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cow-calf-breakeven-calculator/cow-calf-breakeven-price-per-cwt.html)
